sentences.text: At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this application with liberty to the applicant to file a fresh application with proper pleadings and documents in support thereof.
The aforesaid has not been opposed.
In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty, as prayed for.
Office is directed to return certified/original copies of the documents annexed with this application to the learned counsel for the applicant as per relevant Rules in this regard.
